args.title: Corvid Packaging: Freight pricing this quarter — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of Corvid Packaging's newsletter, its linked article (https://blog.corvid.example/2026/freight), and the article's companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/freight/companion):

- Freight spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
